newsitem.title: CHINA: Chinese snap up picture book on Hong Kong tycoon.
newsitem.headline: Chinese snap up picture book on Hong Kong tycoon.

text.p: A pictorial covering the life and times of colourful Hong Kong tycoon Li Ka-shing has proved a sellout in China, despite costing about double the average monthly urban salary.
The picture book, with 360 photographs illustrating the billionaire's lifestyle and meetings with Chinese leaders, is selling for about 600 yuan ($72).

"About 5,000 copies of the first edition have been sold out... Most of the pictures are being published for the first time," the editor with the publisher, affiliated to the official Xinhua news agency, told Reuters by telephone.
Each copy sells for about 600 yuan ($72).
The People's Daily, mouthpiece of the Communist Party, said the pictorial was published in recognition of Li's contribution to the motherland.
Hong Kong returns to China this year after more than 150 years of British rule.
